1=1 AND TNA.STATUS=4 ${mjsql}

SELECT DISTINCT NP.PROJECTID,NP.projectcode,NP.PRJOECTNAME,NP.AUDITTYPE,NP.PLANYEAR,NP.ORGIDNAMES,NP.SECRECTLEVELID,NP.STAFFSCOPEIDS,NP.STAFFSCOPENAMES,SJORG.ORGNAME auditOrg
,(CASE WHEN TD.DAYNUMBER > 0 THEN 1 WHEN TD.DAYNUMBER < 0 THEN 0 WHEN TNB.STATUS > 0 AND TNB.STATUS < 6 THEN 2 ELSE 0 END) pStatus
from TBL_NBSJ_PROJECT NP
LEFT JOIN ( SELECT PROJECTID, (MAX( RETURNDATE )-SYSDATE) DAYNUMBER FROM TBL_NBSJ_BORROWRECORD WHERE 1 = 1 AND STAFFID=#{tblnbsjProjectVo.staffId} GROUP BY PROJECTID ) TD ON NP.PROJECTID = TD.PROJECTID LEFT JOIN (SELECT PROJECTID,MAX(BORROWID) BORROWID FROM TBL_NBSJ_BORROWRECORD WHERE 1 = 1 AND STAFFID = #{tblnbsjProjectVo.staffId} GROUP BY PROJECTID ) TE ON NP.PROJECTID = TE.PROJECTID LEFT JOIN TBL_NBSJ_BORROWRECORD TNB ON TE.BORROWID =TNB.BORROWID
LEFT JOIN TBL_STAFF CRESTAFF ON CRESTAFF.STAFFID = NP.AUDITSTAFFID LEFT JOIN TBL_ORGANIZATION ORG ON ORG.ORGID = NP.AUDITORGID LEFT JOIN TBL_ORGANIZATION SJORG ON SJORG.ORGID = NP.ORGID
NP.STATUS = 4 and NP.orgId = #{tblnbsjProjectVo.orgId} ${mjsql}
and NP.prjoectname like concat(concat('%',#{tblnbsjProjectVo.prjoectName}),'%')
and NP.projectcode like concat(concat('%',#{tblnbsjProjectVo.projectCode}),'%')
and NP.audittype like concat(concat('%',#{tblnbsjProjectVo.auditType}),'%')
and NP.planyear like concat(concat('%',#{tblnbsjProjectVo.projectYear}),'%')
ORDER BY NP.PROJECTID DESC

SELECT DISTINCT TNA.PROJECTID,TNA.projectcode,TNA.PRJOECTNAME,TNA.AUDITTYPE,TNA.PLANYEAR,TNA.SECRECTLEVELID,TNA.STAFFSCOPEIDS,TNA.STAFFSCOPENAMES,TNA.ORGIDNAMES,SJORG.ORGNAME auditOrg,TC.PCOUNT pcount FROM TBL_NBSJ_PROJECT TNA LEFT JOIN (SELECT PROJECTID,COUNT(PROJECTID) PCOUNT FROM TBL_NBSJ_BORROWRECORD TB WHERE 1=1 GROUP BY PROJECTID) TC ON TNA.PROJECTID=TC.PROJECTID LEFT JOIN TBL_STAFF CRESTAFF ON CRESTAFF.STAFFID = TNA.AUDITSTAFFID LEFT JOIN TBL_ORGANIZATION ORG ON ORG.ORGID = TNA.AUDITORGID LEFT JOIN TBL_ORGANIZATION SJORG ON SJORG.ORGID = TNA.ORGID
TNA.STATUS = 4 and TNA.ORGID = #{tblnbsjProjectVo.orgId} ${mjsql}
and TNA.prjoectname like concat(concat('%',#{tblnbsjProjectVo.prjoectName}),'%')
and TNA.projectcode like concat(concat('%',#{tblnbsjProjectVo.projectCode}),'%')
and TNA.audittype like concat(concat('%',#{tblnbsjProjectVo.auditType}),'%')
and TNA.planyear like concat(concat('%',#{tblnbsjProjectVo.projectYear}),'%')
ORDER BY TNA.PROJECTID DESC

SELECT DISTINCT TP.PROJECTID, TP.PROJECTCODE, TP.PRJOECTNAME,TP.STATUS, TA.ORGNAME AUDITORGNAME, TP.ORGIDNAMES ORGNAME, TC.REALNAME, TD.REALNAME PMNAME, TP.PLANYEAR, TP.STARTDATE, TP.ENDDATE,TP.SECRECTLEVELID,TP.STAFFSCOPEIDS,TP.STAFFSCOPENAMES, (TP.ENDDATE-TP.STARTDATE) DAYNUMBER, TP.COSTS FROM TBL_NBSJ_PROJECT TP LEFT JOIN TBL_ORGANIZATION TA ON TP.ORGID = TA.ORGID LEFT JOIN TBL_ORGANIZATION TB ON TP.AUDITORGID = TB.ORGID LEFT JOIN TBL_STAFF TC ON TP.AUDITSTAFFID = TC.STAFFID LEFT JOIN TBL_STAFF TD ON TP.PMID = TD.STAFFID
1 = 1 AND TP.ORGID IN ( ${strs}) ${mjsql}
AND PROJECTCODE like concat(concat('%',#{project.PROJECTCODE}),'%')
AND PRJOECTNAME like concat(concat('%',#{project.PRJOECTNAME}),'%')
AND TA.ORGNAME like concat(concat('%',#{project.AUDITORGNAME}),'%')
AND TP.ORGIDNAMES like concat(concat('%',#{project.ORGNAME}),'%')
AND TC.REALNAME like concat(concat('%',#{project.REALNAME}),'%')
AND TD.REALNAME like concat(concat('%',#{project.PMNAME}),'%')
AND TP.STARTDATE >= #{project.starttime,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}
AND TP.ENDDATE <= #{project.endtime,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}
ORDER BY TP.PROJECTID DESC

SELECT QU.QUESTIONID,TP.PROJECTCODE,TP.PROJECTID, TP.PRJOECTNAME, TP.PLANYEAR, TP.AUDITTYPE, SH.QUESTITLE,NQTYPE.AUDITTYPE AS INTERNALTYPE, TO_CHAR(SH.AUDITDISCOVERABLE) AUDITDISCOVERABLE, TA.ORGNAME AUDITORGNAME, SH.ORGIDNAMES ORGNAME, TC.REALNAME,TP.SECRECTLEVELID,TP.STAFFSCOPEIDS,TP.STAFFSCOPENAMES, TD.REALNAME FINDREALNAME FROM TBL_NBSJ_QUESTION qu LEFT JOIN TBL_NBSJ_SHEET SH ON qu.sheetid = SH.sheetid LEFT JOIN TBL_NBSJ_PROJECT TP ON TP.PROJECTID = SH.PROJECTID LEFT JOIN TBL_ORGANIZATION TA ON TP.ORGID = TA.ORGID LEFT JOIN TBL_ORGANIZATION TB ON TP.AUDITORGID = TB.ORGID LEFT JOIN TBL_STAFF TC ON TP.AUDITSTAFFID = TC.STAFFID LEFT JOIN TBL_STAFF TD ON SH.CREATESTAFF = TD.STAFFID LEFT JOIN TBL_NBSJ_QUESTION_TYPE NQTYPE ON NQTYPE.TYPEID = SH.INTERNALTYPE
tp.orgid IN ( ${strs}) ${mjsql}
AND PROJECTCODE like concat(concat('%',#{question.PROJECTCODE}),'%')
AND PRJOECTNAME like concat(concat('%',#{question.PRJOECTNAME}),'%')
AND TA.ORGNAME like concat(concat('%',#{question.AUDITORGNAME}),'%')
AND TP.ORGIDNAMES like concat(concat('%',#{question.ORGNAME}),'%')
AND TC.REALNAME like concat(concat('%',#{question.REALNAME}),'%')

AND SH.QUESTITLE like concat(concat('%',#{question.QUESTITLE}),'%')
AND NQTYPE.AUDITTYPE like concat(concat('%',#{question.internalType}),'%')

TP.ORGID IN ( ${strs} )
${mjsql}

SELECT DISTINCT TNA.PRJOECTNAME,TNA.AUDITTYPE,TNA.CNTTYPE,TNA.STARTDATE,TNA.ENDDATE,TNA.PROJECTSOURCE,TNA.PLANYEAR,TNA.PROJECTID, CRESTAFF.REALNAME REALNAME,ORG.ORGNAME auditOrgName,NVL(TNA.orgidnames,TS.REALNAME) auditStaffName FROM TBL_NBSJ_PROJECT TNA left join TBL_NBSJ_AUDIT_PROJECDATA dd on TNA.PROJECTID = dd.OLDPROJECTID LEFT JOIN TBL_STAFF CRESTAFF ON CRESTAFF.STAFFID = TNA.PMID LEFT JOIN TBL_STAFF TS ON TS.STAFFID = TNA.AUDITSTAFFID LEFT JOIN TBL_ORGANIZATION ORG ON ORG.ORGID = TNA.AUDITORGID

SELECT TNA.PRJOECTNAME,TNA.AUDITTYPE,TNA.CNTTYPE,TNA.STARTDATE,TNA.ENDDATE,TNA.PROJECTSOURCE,TNA.PLANYEAR,TNA.PROJECTID, CRESTAFF.REALNAME REALNAME,ORG.ORGNAME auditOrgName,NVL(TNA.orgidnames,TS.REALNAME) auditStaffName FROM TBL_NBSJ_PROJECT TNA LEFT JOIN TBL_STAFF CRESTAFF ON CRESTAFF.STAFFID = TNA.PMID LEFT JOIN TBL_STAFF TS ON TS.STAFFID = TNA.AUDITSTAFFID LEFT JOIN TBL_ORGANIZATION ORG ON ORG.ORGID = TNA.AUDITORGID

SELECT LISTAGG(o.ORGNAME, ',') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY o.ORGID) AS orgname, p.PPROJECTNAME AS pprojectname, p.PROJECTID AS projectid, p.STARTDATE AS startdate, p.AUDITTYPE AS audittype, s.REALNAME AS realname, p.PROJECTORGNAME AS projectorgname, p.STATUS AS STATUS, p.PROJECTSOURCE AS projectsource, p.ENDDATE AS enddate, COALESCE(sheet_count.cnt, 0) AS wtzs, COALESCE(zgsl.c, 0) AS zgsl FROM TBL_NBSJ_PROJECT p LEFT JOIN tbl_orgorg o ON FIND_IN_SET(o.ORGID, p.ORGIDS) > 0 LEFT JOIN TBL_STAFF s ON s.STAFFID = p.PMID LEFT JOIN TBL_NBSJ_SHEET e ON e.PROJECTID = p.PROJECTID LEFT JOIN ( SELECT p.PROJECTID, COUNT(0) AS cnt FROM TBL_NBSJ_SHEET s LEFT JOIN TBL_NBSJ_PROJECT p ON s.PROJECTID = p.PROJECTID WHERE IFSBG IS NULL OR IFSBG != 1 GROUP BY p.PROJECTID ) sheet_count ON p.PROJECTID = sheet_count.PROJECTID LEFT JOIN ( SELECT p.PROJECTID, COUNT(0) AS c FROM TBL_ZGZZ_ISSUESILIST i LEFT JOIN TBL_NBSJ_PROJECT p ON i.PROJECTID = p.PROJECTID GROUP BY p.PROJECTID ) zgsl ON p.PROJECTID = zgsl.PROJECTID
1=1
AND TO_CHAR(p.CREATETIME, 'YYYY') = #{year}
GROUP BY p.PPROJECTNAME, p.PROJECTID, p.STARTDATE, p.AUDITTYPE, s.REALNAME, p.PROJECTORGNAME, p.STATUS, p.PROJECTSOURCE, p.ENDDATE, sheet_count.cnt, zgsl.c ORDER BY p.CREATETIME DESC

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ( SELECT p.PROJECTID FROM TBL_NBSJ_PROJECT p LEFT JOIN tbl_orgorg o ON FIND_IN_SET(o.ORGID, p.ORGIDS) > 0 LEFT JOIN TBL_STAFF s ON s.STAFFID = p.PMID LEFT JOIN TBL_NBSJ_SHEET e ON e.PROJECTID = p.PROJECTID
1=1
AND TO_CHAR(p.CREATETIME, 'YYYY') = #{year}
GROUP BY p.PPROJECTNAME, p.PROJECTID, p.STARTDATE, p.AUDITTYPE, s.REALNAME, p.PROJECTORGNAME, p.STATUS, p.PROJECTSOURCE, p.ENDDATE )

SELECT COUNT(1) AS c, CONCAT(YEAR(CREATETIME), '-', LPAD(MONTH(CREATETIME), 2, '0')) AS d FROM TBL_NBSJ_PROJECT WHERE TO_CHAR(PLANYEAR)=SUBSTR(CREATETIME,0,4) AND CREATETIME >= ADD_MONTHS(CURRENT_DATE, -12) AND CREATETIME < ADD_MONTHS(CURRENT_DATE, 0) GROUP BY YEAR(CREATETIME), MONTH(CREATETIME) ORDER BY YEAR(CREATETIME), MONTH(CREATETIME)

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN z.CONCLUSION IN ('已整改', '已整改到位') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS yzg, COUNT(0) - SUM(CASE WHEN z.CONCLUSION IN ('已整改', '已整改到位') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS wzg, SUM(CASE WHEN z.ISXH = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS yxh, SUM(CASE WHEN z.ISXH = '0' OR z.ISXH IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS wxh FROM TBL_ZGZZ_ISSUESILIST i LEFT JOIN TBL_RECTIFICATION_ISSUES r ON i.ISSUESID = r.ISSUESID LEFT JOIN TBL_ZGZZ_RECTIFICATIONIMPL z ON r.RELAID = z.RELAID LEFT JOIN TBL_ORGANIZATION o ON o.ORGID = i.RESPONSIBLEDEPT WHERE i.AUDITOBJECTTYPE = 1 AND i.RESPONSIBLEDEPT IS NOT NULL
